source.decision: Decision card '按复查意见修改 DR、标注和审核吗？': 不加 DR 确认点 (L1, L2, R2, R3, R4 adopted; D1 declined).

gaps_found: Footnotes beside Excel tables went to the unassigned item and were never read by labelling (verified with a workbook).
Page disagreements in a long document (for example rats then mice) blocked QC.
Review could not cite the lines of stated values (bug).
Review saw only the cells labels cited, so it could not find counterevidence labels missed.
Nothing recorded whether labels and review used the same model.
The mandatory review checkpoint had no list of what the person decides.
Declined: a human checkpoint after DR-access.
